content.short: Spot Zero is a 3D anime-style action RPG developed by Tarta Games on Mantle, blending high fantasy with blockchain-powered asset ownership.
content.description: Spot Zero is a visually stunning 3D action role-playing game developed by Tarta Games, featuring an anime art style that combines high fantasy storytelling with intricate mechanical gameplay on the Mantle Network. The game integrates blockchain ownership of in-game assets including characters and equipment, enabling players to own, trade, and earn from their items in a fully decentralized economy. Spot Zero aims to deliver AAA-quality gaming experiences while leveraging the unique benefits of on-chain asset ownership.
